caseName: Air Transport Associates, Inc. v. Civil Aeronautics Board
caseNameFull: Air Transport Associates, Inc. v. Civil Aeronautics Board
attorneys: Warren E. Miller for petitioner., Solicitor General Cummings, Emory T. Nunneley, Jr. and O. D. Ozment for respondent., George M. Morris filed a brief for the Air-coach Transport Association, as amicus curiae, in support of the petition.

opinions.text:
United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit. Certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Black, Mr. Justice Reed, and Mr. Justice Douglas are of the opinion certiorari should be granted.
